svg.text: The tag filter bar overflows on narrow screens.
The filter row doesn't wrap, so long tag lists push past the panel edge.
I'll switch it to a wrapping flex layout and cap the visible tags.
Fixed — the bar now wraps on narrow screens, and all twelve tests pass.
You can review the change in the Git tab on the right.
